Theta GmbH's strategy of filing for multiple patents on next-generation wireless communication is a defensive and offensive move designed to secure a temporary monopoly on specific technologies. This will likely impede our development efforts by creating legal barriers to entry, forcing us to either license their technology, which could increase costs and reduce margins, or to invest significant resources into developing alternative solutions. This could delay our time-to-market and potentially cede market share to Theta if they leverage their patents to block competitors.

A book is primarily made of paper.
